# United Dumplings

> > Women-owned Chinese restaurant in San Francisco serving authentic xiao long bao, frozen dumplings, and catering across Marina, Rockridge, and Bernal locations.

Founded by Sandy and Julia, United Dumplings specializes in Shanghai-style soup dumplings (xiao long bao) with dine-in, frozen takeaway, and corporate catering options. The restaurant operates three Bay Area locations and offers plant-based options alongside traditional Chinese cuisine.

## Soup Dumpling (Xiao Long Bao) Guide

- [The Interesting Story of Soup Dumplings (Xiao Long Bao)](https://www.uniteddumplings.com/blogs/news/the-interesting-story-of-soup-dumplings): Origins of xiao long bao from Shanghai's Nanxiang district
- [Xiao Long Bao vs. Shanghai Soup Dumplings](https://www.uniteddumplings.com/blogs/news/xiao-long-bao-vs-shanghai-soup-dumplings): Exploring the origins and variations of xiao long bao vs Shanghai dumplings
- [Soup Dumpling Dough Thickness Guide](https://www.uniteddumplings.com/blogs/news/soup-dumpling-dough-thickness-guide): Expert guide to achieving perfect wrapper thickness for soup dumplings
- [Dry Soup Dumplings: Why It Happens and How to Fix It](https://www.uniteddumplings.com/blogs/news/dry-soup-dumplings-why-it-happens-and-how-to-fix-it): Troubleshooting dry soup dumplings with steaming and moisture tips
